summary: Physics Lab rolling-cart authored center of mass is inconsistent with its own component masses/positions. Current ObjectGenome data declares centerOfMassM.y = -0.12m, while the mass-weighted Y from four 0.4kg casters at -0.42m, an 8kg chassis at -0.33m, a 3kg lower shelf at -0.08m, and a 3kg upper shelf at +0.28m is approximately -0.173846153846m across 15.6kg total mass. The current HG-BACKFILL-PHYSICS-GEOMETRY lane/slot write scopes do not include PhysicsLabObjectGenomes.luau, so this was not modified. Schedule a bounded follow-up with explicit ObjectGenome write scope and regression coverage rather than widening the audit PR.
evidence: src/shared/Physics/PhysicsLabObjectGenomes.luau rollingCart component mass/position data: 4x0.4kg casters at y=-0.42m; chassis 8kg at y=-0.33m; lower shelf 3kg at y=-0.08m; upper shelf 3kg at y=+0.28m.
Mass-weighted Y = ((4*0.4*-0.42)+(8*-0.33)+(3*-0.08)+(3*0.28))/15.6 = -0.173846153846m, differing from authored centerOfMassM.y=-0.12m by about 0.053846m.
